description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Water], [Gullwinged Perfection] and [Surfeit] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Gullwinged Perfection
description.text: Grants [Physical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using a Water ability

description.name: Surfeit
description.text: Grants [Buff Water 10% (15s)] to all allies after using three Water abilities
